hooks.name: Lint on Save
hooks.description: Run ESLint on the saved .ts/.tsx file and report issues.

action.command: node -e "const i=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');const d=JSON.parse(i);const f=d.file||'';if(!f)process.exit(0);const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('npx eslint --max-warnings 0 \"'+f+'\"',{stdio:'pipe'});console.log('ESLint: no issues in '+f);}catch(e){console.error(e.stdout?e.stdout.toString():e.message);process.exit(1);}"
